author: robin-dev
title: Turn on noUncheckedIndexedAccess
body: Turns on `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` for the whole repo, per EX-60. CI's typecheck is green, so nothing on develop violates it.

linkedIssue.body: Turn on noUncheckedIndexedAccess everywhere, and have CI enforce it from now on.

existingComments.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
existingComments.body: **P1** CI doesn't type-check this flag. With Turbo's remote cache on in CI, this PR's `typecheck` task hashes the same as develop's, because its `inputs` in `turbo.json` list `src/**/*.ts` and `tsconfig.json` but not `tsconfig.base.json`. So CI replays develop's cached pass, and the new flag is never checked.

replies.author: robin-dev
replies.body: CI never restores `.cache/`: there's no cache step for it in ci.yml, and `typecheck` declares no outputs, so tsc runs from scratch on every CI run. The stale-tsbuildinfo case is local only, which is what the docs note covers.
